data.gender_notes: Jaywant is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jaywant is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘jaya’ meaning victory and ‘want’ meaning conqueror. This name is used to denote a brave and victorious individual, one who conquers challenges and obstacles in life. The name Jaywant carries the meaning “Victorious, Conqueror” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jaywant usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, conqueror and live with faith, good character and purpose.
